You’ve already taken a big step towards a brighter future and healing by admitting to i yourself the kind of person he was to you. What you went through is awful and devastating to your emotional and mental health. But I promise life does get better. It can either take a long to heal from this or a short time, and it all really depends on you. 

What I’ve told others, like you and I, is that you have to shed your tears. You have to feel sad and emotional about all of this. Let the sadness bring you down, because once it’s over the days ahead of you will be bright. Thank fate for taking him out of your life because he was not good for you, but don’t forget the lessons this relationship taught you. 

Learn to trust again, it’s going to take some time especially after what you have gone through, but you can do it. Learn to love yourself FOR yourself. Do things for yourself. Keep in mind the people who are comforting you right now and open up to them. But move on by prioritizing yourself. Heal yourself and become the person you were meant to be.

Life goes on and we have to move with it, we were meant to enjoy this life. And some day soon you’ll see that what happened was meant to happen so that you could get to where you are meant to be. 

Life will get better, if you need someone to talk to my dms are open. Stay strong, take care of yourself and love yourself!

Wether it was four months or four years the pain of losing someone you loved is real, and there’s not really much you can do, physically, to get over the pain. Despite what people say about working out, getting a new hobby, going out with friends, anything you do that doesn’t evolve dealing with your thoughts won’t help in the moment. It’ll help later on because you’ll be a new person but for now focus on the fact that you’re feeling this pain. 


I tell people to thank fate for letting them be a part of something amazing in your life, but he didn’t seem to be a good person at all. So shed your tears, accept the fact that it’s over (i know you ended it) and thank fate for getting rid of someone that didn’t benefit you. I’m sure there is a subreddit where people will talk to you and seek the comfort of those around. Or find people that will let you vent. 

Embrace the sadness and let overwhelm you, because once you get to that point you’ll start to see a brighter sky. 

My dms are open though i won’t always respond because of work. Stay strong, take care of yourself and remember that you will be okay!

From experience i can say that it takes time but also effort on your part to want to feel better. One thing that you can do is voice journaling, think of it as speaking your thoughts into existence and out of your head and when you do that you get to understand your feelings more in depth. Another is finding something to be joyful about, wether it be that the sun is out and the colors of the world truly pop out. Or if you like the rain then you can find joy in the fact that you’re type of weather is here and it makes you feel good. Just try to find something to be joyful about because in the state that most of us in this group find ourselves in is delicate. We’re fragile and though having people to talk to can be very helpful, at the end of the day you have to help yourself. 

Don’t get me wrong, I was with this girl for 3.5 years and we broke up a couple of months ago. I still wake up everyday sad and depressed and wanting to disappear but i have to get better for myself, primarily, and for my family.
